messages:
rachel-csm: Heads-up team — MeridianPay usage collapsed ~55% week-over-week. Renewal in ~5w and their ML lead just moved to a competitor. We should treat as high-priority renewal triage (possible swap). Can ops confirm whether this is infra or product friction?

dan-sales: Heard from their procurement: they’ve initiated a briefing with Nimbus Labs. Timeline could accelerate to 2-3w if Nimbus proves perf + price. They asked for a short SLA/perf packet and a runbook for production testing.

luis-eng: Quick check of their telemetry: sudden increase in request concurrency and average prompt length. We also see a rise in 429s and a handful of expensive model variants being hit (longer context). Snippet from logs:```
2024-05-05T09:23:11Z meridian-org-47 200 /generate 120ms
2024-05-05T09:23:12Z meridian-org-47 429 /generate rate_limit
2024-05-05T09:23:12Z meridian-org-47 retry attempt=1 backoff=200ms
```

emma-ops: Looks like throttling + model-choice spike. Proposal: offer a 10-day Dedicated trial (pre-provisioned pool, limited quotas) to reproduce their peak load with their (or sanitized) prompts. We can enable prefix caching + model-variant pinning to show latency improvement.

rachel-csm: Good. What about billing/seat impact — could they have paused due to unexpected costs?

dan-sales: Procurement noted a billing anomaly inquiry last week — possible finance pause. I’ll flag commercial to prep a pilot credit + expedited NDA.

billing-bot: Alert: meridian-org-47 flagged for billing inquiry (invoice 2024-04-28). Ticket BL-3321 opened.

luis-eng: For repro, I need a sample of their real prompts or a close synthetic. If they can’t share PII, we can run sampled anonymized prompts. Also recommend we provide an SDK example for exponential backoff + jitter. Example snippet:```js
async function callGenerate() {
  for (let i=0;i<5;i++){
    const res = await fetch('/v1/generate', { method: 'POST' });
    if (res.status === 429) await sleep(2**i * 100 + jitter());
    else return res;
  }
  throw new Error('rate-limited');
}
```

rachel-csm: Action items: 1) Emma — spin ephemeral Dedicated pool and run focused load test against sanitized prompt set (24-36h). 2) Luis — assemble 1-page perf brief (90th, p95 latencies; token-cost delta vs baseline). 3) Dan — open pilot credit + fast-track NDA, schedule customer check-in. Who will own sequencing on call? I can run enablement and product walkthrough.

emma-ops: I’ll own the repro. Will request pool and run tests tomorrow morning. I’ll post a short results doc with 50/90/95 latency and token usage. ETA 30h.

dan-sales: I’ll send pilot terms and calendar invite. Suggest a 45m triage call: product + eng + procurement. Target Tue 10am ET.

luis-eng: Also recommend we capture a small A/B: current model + cached/pinned variant so they can see deterministic latency and 15-30% token savings in some flows. I’ll include that in the brief.

\rbilling-bot: Note: BL-3321 - finance inquiry pending response. Commercial lead: dan-sales.

rachel-csm: If trial shows clear perf & cost wins we propose a short reserved commit (6w) to lock pricing while they complete procurement. If not, capture exact failure modes and prioritize infra fixes.

emma-ops: One quick ask — should we run their actual templates in the one-off Dedicated trial? Privacy might block it.

dan-sales: If they sign NDA/pilot terms we can use real templates. Otherwise we run sanitized equivalents. I’ll add this as a required question in the invite.

luis-eng: Uploading preliminary checklist to thread: what we need from customer -> sample prompts (or schema), peak QPS, top model variants used, any custom tokenization.

rachel-csm: Great. Tagging owners: @emma-ops (repro), @luis-eng (perf brief), @dan-sales (pilot + commercial). I’ll prep the agenda and a 1-pager comparing to Nimbus (high-level).

emmaa-ops: small typo in tagging above — that was me (emma-ops).

rachel-csm: Noted. Last: ops — create a short pre-read with expected test plan so procurement sees it’s controlled. Goal: convert trial -> short-term reserved commit if metrics align. :rocket:

emma-ops: Creating CS-12101 with test plan now. Will post link in thread when ready.

luis-eng: I’ll draft the perf brief and include an appendix with recommended SDK retry/backoff.

dan-sales: Invite + initial pilot terms sent. Waiting on MeridianPay confirmation.

rachel-csm: Thanks team — follow-ups in thread.
